TREASURE CASE : 2012 T196d. A scattered hoard of Late Roman silver coins; siliqua, consisting of: 2012 T196a (SWYOR-740718): 27 coins (of which 1 has broken into two piece post deposition, and some are fragmentary) recovered by two joint finders. 2012 T196b (SWYOR-5C72E1): 3 coins found by a third finder (of which one is a rare Jovian issue from the Lyon mint, one is fragmentary, and one is a large copper alloy coin). 2012 T196c (SWYOR-3C0EF4): 13 further coins recovered by the original two finders.
